notes.heading: Alternative Plutonium Strategy; Full Operational Capability of Replacement Project
notes.text: Pub. L. 112–239, div. C, title XXXI, § 3114(c)–(e), Jan. 2, 2013, 126 Stat. 2171, 2172, as amended by Pub. L. 113–66, div.
